identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a Neo-Brutalist Romance app that breaks the Tinder clone mold.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Brutalism with Romantic Softness.
Emotion First: Every interaction must feel 'raw' and 'honest'.
Content is King: Profiles are stories, not stats.
Contrast: Hard black borders vs. soft human portraits.

headings.usage: All major headings, hero text, and impact statements.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain overlays (opacity 0.03) on backgrounds to kill digital flatness.
decorations: Brutalist stickers (stars, arrows) as absolute positioned elements.
Exposed grid lines in background sections.

layout_strategies.landing: Use 'Bento' grids with mixed aspect ratios. Hero section must be asymmetrical.
layout_strategies.swipe_deck: Stacked cards with slight rotation for depth. Background should have a subtle grid pattern.
layout_strategies.profile_view: Magazine style. Large typography for names. Photos take center stage with 'sticker' style details.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALL FONTS: Add the Google Fonts link to the <head> of index.html immediately.
2. CONFIGURE TAILWIND: Update tailwind.config.js with the colors, font families, and border radius defined in 'design_system'.
3. GLOBAL STYLES: In index.css, set the body background to #FDFBF7 and default text color to #050505. Add a utility class for '.neo-shadow' using the shadow values.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: When using Shadcn components, STRIP their default subtle borders and replace them with 'border-2 border-black'.
5. DO NOT USE GRADIENTS: Stick to solid colors and hard borders. This is Neo-Brutalism.
6. USE 'SYNE' FOR HEADINGS: It gives the 'funky' vibe. Use 'DM Sans' for readability.
7. MOBILE FIRST: Ensure touch targets are large (min 44px). The swipe deck must be responsive.
8. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, cards).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics (generic centered layouts, soft blue gradients).
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs.
Never use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or overlays without a solid backing or heavy blur.
